say:3:1510403002:0.text: This is the <style="highlight">Taothos Rift</style>. It's the natural divide that has long separated the Halian lands from the Wildborn territory, preserving peace between our peoples for generations.

say:5:1510403004:1.text: Halia must've lost many soldiers and workers to build this outpost and bridge.
say:5:1510403004:1.source_cn: 为了建造这座哨站与大桥，呼临应该也牺牲了不少士兵和工匠。

say:6:1510403005:0.text: All of this was done to claim Wildborn land and ease their hunger... Twisted by a corrupt god, those once suffering became the oppressors. But now, the oppressed have summoned a deity of their own.
say:6:1510403005:0.source_cn: 所有一切，只是为了抢夺雅库伯尔的土地，缓解呼临的饥荒…...
say:6:1510403005:0.male: All of this was done to claim Wildborn land and ease their hunger... Twisted by a corrupt god, those once suffering became the oppressors. But now, the oppressed have summoned a deity of their own.
say:6:1510403005:0.female: All of this was done to claim Wildborn land and ease their hunger... Twisted by a corrupt god, those once suffering became the oppressors. But now, the oppressed have summoned a deity of their own.

say:7:1510403006:0.text: It's tragic how everything is bound together...
say:7:1510403006:0.source_cn: 如此环环相扣，真是令人悲哀。
